newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian deficit on course in Jan - state auditor.
newsitem.headline: Italian deficit on course in Jan - state auditor.

text.p: Italy's public sector deficit is "in line with expectations" so far this month, state auditor Andrea Monorchio told reporters on Thursday.
"The January data is good," Monorchio said.

Asked if Italy would need a mini-budget to meet 1997 financial targets, Monorchio replied: "I don't know how one can talk about a corrective budget without first seeing data from the first three months".

Financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said in an unsourced report on Wednesday that early 1997 data pointed to a worse -than-expected public sector deficit this year underlining the need for a hefty mini-budget.
